decisions.story_title: F5 and Juniper Networks Patch Critical Vulnerabilities
decisions.reason: Real security advisories: F5 fixes critical NGINX RCE flaws (CVE-2026-15176, CVE-2026-93479, CVE-2026-97205) and Juniper publishes 150+ Junos defects; substantial advisory content.
Cert Poland advisory for CVE-2026-106030 in NordVPN; fits existing NordVPN vulnerability story.
GBHackers report on 20,000 malicious Cloudflare Pages subdomains used by Help TDS; fits existing story.
BeyondTrust zero-day (CVE-2026-102764) exploitation by China-nexus actor, log deletion; matches active-exploitation story.
European Commission/Europol digital forensic capabilities report; not a security event or vulnerability.
Critical unauthenticated OS command injection in Collabora Online (CVE-2026-110447, CVSS 9.2) affecting Nextcloud; matches active exploitation story.
Report on AI agents exploiting PaperCut NG/MF, 440 compromised systems, credential theft; fits existing PaperCut AI-agents story.
CoGUI phishing kit disruption by Microsoft; fits existing story.
Critical Linux kernel VM escape (CVE-2026-99999 / PwnEscape) found via AI-assisted research; fits existing PwnEscape story.
